title: Transcendence degree of a finite-variable polynomial algebra over a domain
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative integral domain, meaning a nonzero commutative ring without zero divisors, and let $n\geq0$ be an integer. For the polynomial algebra $R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], the transcendence degree [def-kun-transcendence-degree] is $\operatorname{trdeg}_R R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]=n$. The case $n=0$ means $R$ itself.
